notes.note: Tile title: the share of forwarded queries the DNS cache answered, in percent.

{entries} is the number of cache entries with an SI suffix; {stale} the stale answers per second (served from an expired entry while the upstreams fail). Kept short: it shares the area of two lines with the window line.

The line under the figure of the cache tile: the number is the hit ratio over the last 30 seconds (hits over hits and misses, not an average of per-second ratios) and each bar of the chart is the same ratio over a bucket of 5 seconds with fixed edges (six completed buckets and the one in progress, drawn lighter); the number is the ratio over the six completed buckets and changes when a bucket completes. The cache hint line gives the stale answers per second as the mean over the same 30 seconds.
Tile title: the DNS answers by response code.

The line under the figure of the answers tile: the number is the share of the answers with the response code NOERROR over the last 30 seconds and each bar of the chart is the same share over a bucket of 5 seconds with fixed edges (six completed buckets and the one in progress, drawn lighter). The rows list each response code per second as the mean over those 30 seconds.
